text:
marina: heads-up i rolled Ivy-9B (int4) into a 5-node canary. noticing p99 tail up ~20% for short-chat flows.

sanjay: p95 fine, p99 spikes when batch>4 and on cold-starts. logs show big memcpy spikes and occasional OOM-fallbacks.

lucas: can you paste a log sample?

marina: snippet:
```
[2026-03-21T11:08:12Z] w-4 req=id123 batch=6 max_new_tokens=64
[2026-03-21T11:08:12Z] w-4 kv_miss shard=3 alloc_try=1
[2026-03-21T11:08:12Z] w-4 memcpy=29ms compute=16ms total_p99=120ms
[2026-03-21T11:08:12Z] w-4 OOM-fallback reclaimed=110MB
```

anya: sounds like fragmentation + prefetch allocations. are int4 prefetches enabled?

marina: yes default prefetch=on. i toggled prefetch=false on a node subset and saw p99 drop ~10ms.

sanjay: let's run two quick ablations on prod-sampled replay:
- config-a: prefetch=false, max_batch=4, slot_reserve_mb=128, eviction_threshold=0.65
- config-b: prefetch=true, max_batch=3, warmup_slot_reserve_mb=256 for 20s, eviction_threshold=0.75

deploy-bot: deploying config-a to canary group.

marina: config-a run (40m) finished. artifact: /replay/ivy/20260321/a.json

anya: results-a: p99 -11ms, OOM-fallbacks -70%, small QA EM drop ~0.7%.

marina: starting config-b now.

deploy-bot: config-b run complete. artifact: /replay/ivy/20260321/b.json

lucas: results-b: p99 -6ms, OOM-fallbacks -38%, QA stable. warmup helps coldstarts but steady gains smaller.

sanjay: tradeoff: a = better latency but slight QA regression; b = safer. propose promote b as default canary and run a 24h variant of a with max_new_tokens_default=96 to see if QA recovers. also open perf ticket for memcpy vector path.

marina: agreed. rolling b to ivy-int4-canary-safe. i'll kick off 24h a-variant on group-delta. updated model catalog notes with recommended canary defaults.

luca[sic]: i'll file RI-2026-ivy-int4-memcpy with traces attached.

sanjay: follow-ups: (1) 24h a-variant, (2) perf investigation, (3) add warmup to onboarding template.

marina: thanks team. will report back after 24h. :rocket:
